author: UFC / ESPN official athlete portrait (photographer not credited)

author: UFC / ESPN official athlete portrait (photographer not credited)
note: Full body three-quarter (Jun 2026): compact, thick-chested muscular build, smooth (not shredded) abdomen, strong thighs and calves, white Venum shorts with a grey leaf pattern; no visible tattoos.

author: UFC / ESPN official athlete portrait (photographer not credited)

author: Getty Images via SuperSport (photographer not captured)
